title: Pure Infinitrack
summary: Infinitrack cards with generic EARTH Machine Xyz Monsters and staples. Infinitrack is an EARTH Machine Xyz deck. The Level 5 Infinitracks summon themselves by tributing an EARTH Machine, and Harvester and Anchor Drill merge Levels so any pair becomes the Rank you need. Infinitrack Harvester searches an Infinitrack. Infinitrack Brutal Dozer pulls another Infinitrack from the Deck when summoned from the hand. Infinitrack Road Roller, the newest card, summons itself whenever an EARTH Machine is tributed or banished face-up. An Xyz with it as material turns their monsters to Defense Position with 1000 less DEF. The Xyz Monsters attach what they destroy in battle, Outrigger Extension ranks up two at a time, and Infinitrack Fortress Megaclops stacks three Xyz into an untouchable Link. Brutal Dozer and Outrigger Extension limit you to EARTH Machines for the turn.
